defects.title: LabScript-AI's simulator harness (backend/pylabrobot_utils.py setup_simulation_environment) and the protocol template hard-code ChatterBoxBackend, which raises NotImplementedError ('ChatterBoxBackend is deprecated') in the unpinned current pylabrobot, so no protocol can ever simulate successfully; in addition the code-extraction step only strips a leading ```python fence, so model prose/markdown is spliced into the function body and causes SyntaxErrors that the correction loop never escapes.
defects.expected_behavior: A syntactically valid protocol for the configured deck is simulated with a working backend (LiquidHandlerChatterboxBackend or a pinned pylabrobot), and only extracted code is inserted into the template; simulation failures caused by the harness itself are distinguished from protocol errors.
defects.observed_behavior: Reproduced in 2 of 2 rounds on d47ef6cb14ab (09fa98d5-20261010T000050Z): all 14 final simulations across both rounds reported success=false - 11 SyntaxErrors caused by model prose/markdown (em-dash, arrows, emoji, '**Error Diagnosis:**', fences) inserted verbatim into the protocol body, and 3 NotImplementedError 'ChatterBoxBackend is deprecated' from the harness setup_simulation_environment whenever the code did parse. No round ever reached a passing simulation.
